name: CaesarPad
notes: No build needed: the published app contains no game data and the player adds their own files in the app. Listed while the Public Repo Audit Tracker row allows its existing public release.

steps: Download the CaesarPad IPA from https://github.com/chrissotraidis/caesarpad/releases and check it against the SHA-256 file beside it.
Install it with AltStore Classic, SideStore or Sideloadly, signed with your own Apple ID.
Put your own Caesar III data folder (with c3.eng and c3.sg2) in Files. Open CaesarPad, select that folder and tap Open.
